title: tc-gate-config
description: When a person decides: the conditions that pause a run, who reviews, what they see, what they may do and why.

value.description: The gate's config. Changed by the user unless a tc-value-change listener calls preventDefault()

conditions.description: The conditions that can pause a run, each shown as a switch

reviewers.description: Who can review, offered in the Reviewer select

views.description: What a reviewer can be shown, offered as a segmented control – two to four work best

actions.description: The actions a reviewer may be allowed, shown as checkboxes

heading.description: Names the group, shown at the top

description.description: A quieter line under the heading, e.g. which step the gate guards

flat.description: Drops the tray and the card, for a gate inside another card

name.description: Submitted with the form: the config as JSON

disabled.description: Turns every control off and leaves the config out of the form; a disabled fieldset does the same

label.description: "Confidence is low" – also used, lower-cased, in the sentence

description.description: A quieter line under the label

phrase.description: In the sentence after "reviews": "the output with its evidence"; defaults to the label

description.description: Shown under the control when it's picked

id.description: approve, edit, send-back, escalate and reject by default

description.description: A quieter line under the label
